bitcoin_articles.headline: WisdomTree Updates Bitcoin-to-Gold Valuation Model
bitcoin_articles.summary: WisdomTree has updated its Bitcoin-to-Gold (BiG) valuation model, which currently suggests that Bitcoin is approximately 26% undervalued relative to gold.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Mega Matrix Announces Initial Purchase of 12 Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Mega Matrix Inc. has disclosed its first-ever acquisition of 12 bitcoins as part of its corporate treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: KULR Technology Group Reports Sale of 300 Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: KULR Technology Group, Inc. has sold 300 Bitcoin for approximately $24.36 million, marking a significant shift in its corporate treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: LQWD Technologies Increases Bitcoin Treasury
bitcoin_articles.summary: LQWD Technologies Corp. has acquired an additional five Bitcoin to add to its corporate treasury, continuing its strategy of accumulating Bitcoin as productive network capital.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Fold Holdings Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
bitcoin_articles.summary: Fold Holdings, Inc. reported its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, highlighting a challenging period marked by lower transaction volumes and revenue due to broader Bitcoin market pressures.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company Increases Bitcoin Holdings to 2,830 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company PLC has acquired an additional 25 Bitcoin, bringing its total treasury holdings to 2,830 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Exodus Movement Sells Bitcoin to Fund W3C Payments Acquisition
bitcoin_articles.summary: Exodus Movement, Inc. sold 1,076 bitcoins during the first quarter of 2026 to raise $73.2 million for its $175 million acquisition of W3C's payments business.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Announces April 2026 Production and Operations Update
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group reported its unaudited operational results for April 2026, highlighting a 372% year-over-year increase in Bitcoin production to 783 BTC and the launch of its SEALMINER A4 series.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Charles Schwab Launches Spot Cryptocurrency Trading for Retail Investors
bitcoin_articles.summary: Charles Schwab has officially launched spot cryptocurrency trading for U.S. retail clients, allowing direct trading of Bitcoin and Ethereum through its platform.
